name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, captivated by the intricate electronics powering Formula One cars. He pursued a degree in electrical engineering and quickly immersed himself in the world of racing. After a decade honing his skills in various Japanese motorsport series, Kenji sought new challenges in NASCAR, drawn by the technical diversity and raw power of the cars. His meticulous approach to problem-solving and unwavering focus on optimizing performance have earned him a reputation as a highly sought-after engineer.

At Stewart-Haas Racing, Kenji is responsible for ensuring the reliability and efficiency of all electronic systems on the race cars. He meticulously analyzes data, identifying areas for improvement and implementing innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. His dedication to continuous improvement and his deep understanding of complex electronic systems make him a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Kenji apart is his relentless pursuit of perfection. He is never satisfied with 'good enough' and constantly pushes himself and his team to achieve the highest standards. His demanding nature, coupled with his deep technical knowledge, ensures that the team's electronics are always performing at their peak.

physical.description: Kenji is of average height, with a lean build, and always wears glasses.

Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
